datasets.access: downloaded raw TXT and MATLAB files
datasets.limitations: Developer benchmark; a pilot reproduction, not an independent blind test.

datasets.access: Public listing has 24 numerical workbooks (trials 2-25), plus videos and report; trial 10 downloaded and publisher checksum verified
datasets.used: Read-only raw-sensor audit and CSV extraction
datasets.limitations: Further downloads returned HTTP 429/timeouts. QES passive plume does not implement two-phase release, evaporation, heat transfer or density feedback.

datasets.access: Public metadata verified; raw archive not downloaded
datasets.limitations: Primarily source discharge/blowdown; not automatically a 3D obstacle dispersion benchmark.

datasets.access: 11 public files downloaded; all publisher MD5 verified
datasets.used: Data quality and physical applicability audit
datasets.limitations: README describes a 100 litre vessel evaporation/oxygen enrichment experiment. Not an outdoor dispersion validation set. Dates in README, META and filenames disagree.

datasets.access: 22 ZIP archives and README downloaded; publisher MD5 and archive CRC verified
datasets.used: Raw CSV extraction and schema inspection
datasets.limitations: 29 concentration sensors plus discharge and pressure. Buoyancy/jet/ventilation physics must be matched before QES comparison.

datasets.access: Dataset ZIP downloaded, two lab geometries and sensor CSVs inspected
datasets.used: Sensor-coordinate matching, missing values and time-order audit
datasets.limitations: Helium is not H2. Geometry coordinate transform, concentration units and HVAC conditions must be established. Some CSV entries are #N/A.

datasets.access: Digitized/curated CSV and validation code downloaded from official Sandia repository
datasets.used: All four upstream HyRAM concentration validation tests run and passed
datasets.limitations: Integral jet model test, not a QES or obstacle-flow test. Not a liquid-phase hydrogen release.

datasets.access: Curated CSV and validation code downloaded
datasets.used: Six upstream HyRAM normalized-concentration tests run and passed
datasets.limitations: These temperatures exceed hydrogen critical temperature. Cryogenic does not mean liquid. No obstacle/wind coupling tested.

datasets.access: NIST FDS public processed concentration/profile CSVs downloaded
datasets.limitations: Processed spatial summaries, not the complete raw campaign. Passive QES is physically inadequate for dense cold near-field clouds.
Requires evaporation and dense-gas physics for a valid model comparison.

datasets.access: Concentration summaries for Falcon 1/3/4 and additional profile files downloaded
datasets.limitations: Includes a vapor barrier scenario; not solved by the passive tracer implementation.
Raw full-field data not included in these small summary tables.

datasets.access: Open file metadata inspected; ~10 GB fields/mesh not downloaded
datasets.limitations: Full raw OpenFOAM reference and interpolated fields available, but boundary/source matching has not been performed.
